stories.headline: Democrats gain additional congressional seats, including NJ House and SC Senate
stories.body: New Jersey 7th House district projected flipped from Republican Tom Kean to Democrat Rebecca Bennett. Reuters' substantially revised older election article reports South Carolina Senate flip by Democrat Annie Andrews; precise revision timestamp unknown. Earlier Reuters Asian market report observed US 10Y yield down 6bp at 4.906%, S&P500 futures -0.8% and Nasdaq futures -1.8%; not attributable specifically to the subsequently reported seat flips.
stories.analysis: Changes the path to congressional control and potentially fiscal/tech oversight; chambers remain undecided.
stories.watch_next: Watch additional Senate/House races, certifications, fiscal policy statements and rate market reaction.

stories.headline: AMD discloses $1.07bn noncash charge tied to AI-customer equity warrants
stories.body: AMD recorded Q3 USD1.07bn noncash warrant charge, equal to 66 cents per share. OpenAI and Meta warrants could separately allow ownership stakes of roughly 10%, conditional on vesting and exercise. More AMD guidance on warrant conditions expected in 2027.
stories.analysis: Strong AI growth coexists with dilutive equity incentives; noncash charge not immediate cash expenditure.
stories.watch_next: Monitor vesting conditions, diluted share count and cash gross margins.
